notes.text: I miss a lot about you. About us, everyday of my life I do
I miss the way you exist in your own world and always look caught whenever I see you
I miss how you stand on your own foot when you're doing something then forget you did that and try to move like that
I miss your food. Coming to your house and smelling it always made bad days good
I miss the way you'd sing under your voice like you're too shy to let anyone hear it. But I always did.
I miss watching you. Freely, shamelessly. Watching you exist everyday, doing things
I miss listening to you, hearing your funny thoughts, your happy thoughts, sad ones too. Excited thoughts.
I miss your vns where you'd forget you did them and I'd spend a while hearing you do random things
I miss the way you feel. Not just physically but being around you. You always feel like home. Smell like it too
I miss the way you feel in my hands. So soft and present. So home
I miss the way you taste. The way your mouth feels on mine. The way you shiver when my tongue goes there. The way your legs shake when you get there
I miss the way you care. The way people you love matter
I miss being loved by you. It's like being lit on fire but in a good way. The way you're just there

If you've made it this far then I'm sure you can start to hear it. I miss loving you. Watching you be loved. Watching you grow and be you more and more. Watching you come out of your shell and be. I miss you. Every day. It doesn't hurt much anymore. But it does feel like this. I've accepted that it's never not going to happen at this point
